target_customer: Security teams at crypto exchanges, fintechs, banks, healthcare and tax portals
problem: Attackers can hijack DNS, BGP or TLS issuance to impersonate a site while the browser lock icon looks valid, and companies lack outside-in monitoring across layers.
business_model: B2B SaaS monitoring subscription, pricing not public
product_category: Cybersecurity, external attack surface and impersonation monitoring

founders.name: Henry Birge-Lee
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: invented the MPIC standard, member of CA/Browser Forum, founded Open MPIC, IRTF applied networking research prize.

founders.name: Grace Cimaszewski
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; web PKI researcher.

founders.name: Prateek Mittal
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: IEEE Fellow; alumni awards from IIT Guwahati and UIUC.

competitors.name: CloudSEK BeVigil
competitors.what: General external attack surface monitoring across web, API, DNS and SSL

competitors.name: Cisco ThousandEyes
competitors.what: BGP and DNS monitoring for infrastructure, including root DNS prefixes since January 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs distributed probes across autonomous systems and cross-layer correlation of BGP, DNS, TLS and JavaScript signals, built on founders' research.

defensibility.rationale: Founders invented the MPIC standard now used by major certificate authorities, giving research credibility; the monitoring product itself has limited disclosed traction.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: The company cites impersonation of sites despite valid TLS, and targets crypto, banking and healthcare. It references the Bybit hack analysis and MPIC adoption for over 3 billion certificates as evidence of the threat.

branding.domain_note: Uses crosslayerlabs.com, not the bare name.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and security-focused with calls to get a security assessment

brand_strength.rationale: Name describes cross-layer monitoring; trademark for Crosslayer Networks exists in semiconductors but is unrelated. No press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Crosslayer Labs is a Winter 2026 spinout of a Princeton lab whose founders created the MPIC certificate standard. It has expert founders but no disclosed customers or revenue. Success will depend on turning research credibility into paid security contracts against established attack surface vendors.
notes: Round is the company's own listing of backers (YC, AE Investments, Long Journey) with no amount or date, so stage is other. CB Insights lists about $500K with different investors and VCBacked shows an April 2026 grant; aggregators disagree, so those are unverified. Headquarters conflict: NYC per YC, Princeton elsewhere. The company site photo captions did not match names. Success factors reflect founder pedigree, not outcome. No outcome news found.
